card.fact_statement: Angola had previously made efforts to mediate peace talks before the 2025 DRC–Rwanda peace agreement.
card.source_span: There were previous efforts to mediate peace talks by Kenya and Angola that did not lead to a lasting agreement.

target_qa_variants.question: Quel pays avait précédemment fait des efforts pour mener une médiation dans les pourparlers de paix avant l'accord de paix de 2025 entre la RDC et le Rwanda ?
target_qa_variants.source_span: There were previous efforts to mediate peace talks by Kenya and Angola that did not lead to a lasting agreement.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'DRC' to 'RDC' (République démocratique du Congo) as it is the standard French acronym.

backtranslation_en.question: Which country had previously made efforts to mediate in the peace talks before the 2025 peace agreement between the DRC and Rwanda?
